Your answering call comes back as a growl. Claws take shape beside you, already flexing against the earth.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One visible unoccupied placement within 3 squares that fits the chosen form's entire footprint.
Type
Magic / Summoning

Choose one Animal entry from the summon selection with a minimum tier of 3 or lower. Call one instance using its summon profile. Choose the form anew each casting. It remains for one scene.
